final.answer: ELEN3016A is Control I (18 NQF credits, approximately 180 total notional learning hours). It is taken as EFA03 Year 3 compulsory; EFA04 Year 3 compulsory. Academic staff/lecturer(s): Prof M. A. van Wyk; Dr M. Ngwako. Course coordinator: Prof M. A. van Wyk. Source: verified 2026 CBO.

hours.weekly_workload_guidance: Four timetable sessions are allocated weekly with two or three used for lectures and one or two for structured tutorials; no total weekly workload is stated.
